channel.title: Swarmsite — notes on redesigning a website
channel.description: Practical guides from Swarmsite: redesigning a website without losing what works, putting it online, and making a landing page for an app.

item.title: Redesign a website without losing your Google rankings
item.description: A new look does not cost you rankings. Changed addresses, lost words and a forgotten noindex do. What to keep, what to redirect, and a checklist for the switch.

item.title: Your app works. Now it needs a landing page
item.description: You built a first version of an app. What its landing page has to answer in the first screen, how to show the product, and what never to invent.

item.title: How to put an HTML and CSS website online, with your own domain
item.description: You have a folder with index.html in it. Three free ways to put it online, how to connect your own domain, and what to check once it is live.
